purpose: Define deterministic validation that every canonical node is reachable through one or more Topics or explicitly represented as outsider, including inherited and composed Topic resolution.

topics.name: Topic Validation
topics.purpose: Define deterministic validation that every canonical node is reachable through one or more Topics or explicitly represented as outsider, including inherited and composed Topic resolution.

semantics.coverage_rule: Every machine-significant canonical node resolves to >=1 Topic or explicit outsider.
semantics.multi_topic_rule: All memberships are preserved; validation never chooses a single preferred Topic unless a separate rule requires it.
semantics.inheritance_rule: Inherited memberships are included in coverage resolution.
semantics.composition_rule: Composed Topic components remain recursively traceable.
semantics.report_rule: Validation reports direct membership, inherited membership, composed membership and outsider state separately.

invariants.rule: Every machine-significant canonical node is classified by explicit Topic membership or explicitly marked outsider; Topics may inherit and compose other Topics.

hard_gates.condition: canonical node absent from both Topic graph and outsider set
validator collapses multi-Topic membership to one Topic

references.purpose: Explicit outsider state satisfies visible classification requirement.
